title: Spin cut to 37min (HRV gate)
coachNotes:
DONE: 37min spin, 135bpm avg, max 148, RPE 2, icu load 31.
REST OF DAY: no extra spin. Walk at MXP and BCN is enough.
FUEL: 1L water before the flight, 500ml on board, carb-heavy dinner, no alcohol.
SLEEP: lights out by 23:00, 7h+ is the target for Tue.
WHY: HRV 42 (52 Sun, 76 Sat), sleep 5.8h. Gate was HRV under 50 = 40min only, extra 30 dropped. RHR 48 is normal, so this reads as sleep and travel stress, not deep fatigue. 30min more at load ~25 adds nothing to VWT fitness and puts Tue 6x4min at risk.
